identity.title: [v0.92][C-SDLC][defect] Permit authored design refresh after implemented recovery repairs

values.summary: Implement and test authored-design refresh provenance for the next installed owner binary. Issue-local refresh audit events created during #417 by the prior installed binary are retained as truthful non-proving self-hosting history and are not claimed to contain the new fields.
actual_changes: Add a refresh-specific implemented recovery-epoch predicate without widening the shared card-repair classifier.
Accept the exact recover_review, supported repair, recover_design_review, authored refresh sequence while retaining the bounded assignment-only immediate and iterative compatibility route.
Make the candidate binary record the originating recovery sequence and generation in authored-refresh audit evidence; prove the emitted fields through public-operation tests.
Retain #417 audit events generated by the prior installed binary as non-proving self-hosting history rather than rewriting or overstating them.
Add public-operation success, authority-clear, provenance, compatibility, absent/stale/unrelated/superseded, and canonical no-mutation regressions.

actual_validation.purpose: Run the C-SDLC v2 library test suite after review remediation.
Run focused issue #417 recovery, provenance, compatibility, and negative regressions after review remediation.
